source_row.stem: Documentation for a telehealth visit generally should include:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Documented mainly when the client specifically requests that a record of the visit be kept","B":"Considered less necessary for a visit conducted virtually rather than in person","C":"Limited mainly to billing codes, with little accompanying clinical content from the visit itself","D":"The same essential elements as an in-person visit, plus specific details about the telehealth modality used"}}
source_row.rationale: Telehealth visit documentation should generally include the same essential clinical elements as an in-person visit, plus specific details about the telehealth modality used and any technical or access considerations.
source_row.source_name: American Telemedicine Association — Telehealth Documentation Standards
